name: Rebuild the search index
summary: Makes Windows Search or Spotlight discard its index and build it again, the fix for searches that miss files or never finish.
risk_note: Search results are incomplete until the rebuild finishes, which can take hours on a full disk, and indexing uses noticeable disk and CPU meanwhile. No files are touched, only the index. A search service that is disabled stays disabled.

windows: Stops the Windows Search service, sets SetupCompletedSuccessfully to 0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Search (which makes the service rebuild its index on start), and starts it again.
Does nothing where Windows Search is not installed or is disabled (the default on Windows Server).
darwin: Runs mdutil -E / to erase and rebuild the Spotlight index of the startup volume.
Does nothing where Spotlight indexing has been turned off for that volume.
